SELECT DISTINCT
    "es"."name",
    "es"."event_space"
FROM "eventspaces" AS "es"
WHERE "es"."capacity" = 200
  AND (
      LOWER("es"."event_space") LIKE '%banquet%'
      OR LOWER("es"."event_space") LIKE '%conference%'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
    es."name",
    es."event_space"
FROM "eventspaces" es
WHERE es."capacity" = 200
  AND (
        LOWER(es."event_space") LIKE '%banquet%'
     OR LOWER(es."event_space") LIKE '%conference%'
  )
ORDER BY es."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT r."name"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%'
  AND LOWER(r."food_service") LIKE '%restaurant%'

UNION


SELECT r."name"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%'
  AND LOWER(r."food_service") LIKE '%cafe%';

SELECT "name", "address", "food_service", "cuisine"
FROM "restaurants"
WHERE LOWER("food_service") LIKE '%restaurant%'
   OR (LOWER("food_service") LIKE '%cafe%' AND LOWER("cuisine") LIKE '%italian%')
ORDER BY "name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT DISTINCT r."name", r."food_service"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%'
  AND (LOWER(r."food_service") LIKE '%restaurant%' OR LOWER(r."food_service") LIKE '%cafe%');

SELECT r."name"
FROM "room" r
WHERE (LOWER(r."name") LIKE '%lobby%' OR LOWER(r."name") LIKE '%terrace%')
  AND r."size" >= 500;

SELECT "r"."name"
FROM "room" AS "r"
WHERE LOWER("r"."name") LIKE '%lobby%'
   OR LOWER("r"."name") LIKE '%лобби%'
   OR (LOWER("r"."name") LIKE '%terrace%' AND "r"."size" = 500)
   OR (LOWER("r"."name") LIKE '%террас%' AND "r"."size" = 500);

SELECT DISTINCT r."name"
FROM "room" r
WHERE r."size" = 500
  AND (LOWER(r."indoor_outdoor_space") LIKE '%lobby%'
       OR LOWER(r."indoor_outdoor_space") LIKE '%terrace%');

SELECT "name"

SELECT "name"

  AND "price" = 150.0;

SELECT "name"
FROM "relaxation_spot"

SELECT "name", "type", "price"
FROM "relaxation_spot"

  AND ("type" ILIKE '%day spa%' OR "type" ILIKE '%wellness retreat%');

SELECT "name", "event_space", "capacity"
FROM "eventspaces"
WHERE LOWER("event_space") LIKE '%banquet%'

SELECT DISTINCT c."name"
FROM "customers" c
JOIN "customer_bookings" cb ON cb."customerid" = c."id"
JOIN "bookings" b ON b."id" = cb."bookingid"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."id" = b."roomid"
WHERE LOWER(c."vacation_option") LIKE '%cruise%'
  AND LOWER(c."activities") LIKE '%dance%'

UNION


SELECT DISTINCT c."name"
FROM "customers" c
JOIN "customer_bookings" cb ON cb."customerid" = c."id"
JOIN "bookings" b ON b."id" = cb."bookingid"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."id" = b."roomid"
WHERE LOWER(c."vacation_option") LIKE '%resort%'
  AND LOWER(c."activities") LIKE '%dance%'

SELECT c."name", c."email", c."phonenumber"
FROM "customers" c
WHERE c."vacation_option" LIKE '%cruise%'

UNION


SELECT c."name", c."email", c."phonenumber"
FROM "customers" c
WHERE c."vacation_option" LIKE '%resort%'
  AND c."activities" LIKE '%dance%'

SELECT DISTINCT
    c."name",
    c."email",
    c."vacation_option"
FROM "customers" c
JOIN "customer_bookings" cb ON cb."customerid" = c."id"
JOIN "bookings" b ON b."id" = cb."bookingid"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."id" = b."roomid"
WHERE c."activities" LIKE '%dance%'
  AND (c."vacation_option" LIKE '%cruise%' OR c."vacation_option" LIKE '%resort%')
ORDER BY c."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT h."name" AS hotel_name
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE c."name" LIKE '%New York%'
  AND lf."feature" LIKE '%swimming%'

UNION


SELECT h."name" AS hotel_name
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE c."name" LIKE '%New York%'
  AND lf."feature" LIKE '%hot tub%'

SELECT h."name" AS hotel_name
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE c."name" LIKE '%New York%'
  AND lf."feature" ILIKE '%pool%'
  AND lf."feature" NOT ILIKE '%hot tub%'

UNION


SELECT h."name" AS hotel_name
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE c."name" LIKE '%New York%'
  AND lf."feature" ILIKE '%hot tub%'

SELECT DISTINCT h."name"
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE c."name" LIKE '%New York%'
  AND (lf."feature" ILIKE '%swimming pool%' OR lf."feature" ILIKE '%hot tub%')

SELECT DISTINCT g."fullname"
FROM "guests" g
JOIN "bookings" b ON b."guestid" = g."id"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."roomid" = b."roomid"
WHERE LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%guest%'

UNION


SELECT DISTINCT g."fullname"
FROM "guests" g
JOIN "bookings" b ON b."guestid" = g."id"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."roomid" = b."roomid"
JOIN "services" s ON s."serviceid" = r."serviceid"
WHERE LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%suite%'
  AND LOWER(s."amenity") LIKE '%air%condition%'

SELECT DISTINCT
    g."fullname",
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%suite%' THEN 'air-conditioned suite'
        ELSE 'air-conditioned guest room'
    END AS "roomcategory"
FROM "bookings" b
JOIN "guests" g ON g."id" = b."guestid"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."roomid" = b."roomid"
JOIN "services" s ON s."serviceid" = r."serviceid"
WHERE LOWER(s."amenity") LIKE '%air%condition%'
   OR LOWER(s."description") LIKE '%air%condition%'
ORDER BY "roomcategory" ASC NULLS FIRST, "fullname" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT DISTINCT g."fullname"
FROM "guests" g
JOIN "bookings" b ON b."guestid" = g."id"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."roomid" = b."roomid"
JOIN "services" s ON s."serviceid" = r."serviceid"
WHERE (LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%guest room%' OR LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%suite%')
  AND LOWER(s."amenity") LIKE '%air condition%';

SELECT c."channel_value"
FROM "channels" c
JOIN "customer_service_representatives_channels" crc ON crc."channel_id" = c."channel_id"
GROUP BY c."channel_id", c."channel_value"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT crc."representative_id") = (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "id") FROM "customer_service_representatives"
);

SELECT
    csr."full_name" AS representative_name,
    ch."channel_value" AS channel_value
FROM "customer_service_representatives" csr
JOIN "customer_service_representatives_channels" csrch
    ON csrch."representative_id" = csr."id"
JOIN "channels" ch
    ON ch."channel_id" = csrch."channel_id"
ORDER BY csr."full_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, ch."channel_value" ASC NULLS FIRST;

JOIN "building_roles" br

HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT bfr."bankid") = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "bankid") FROM "banks")
ORDER BY fr."rolename" ASC NULLS FIRST;

HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cbr."construction_company_id") = (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "id") FROM "construction_companies"
